statements.t: With OPUS-1 serving as the foundation of our planned Biologics License Application (BLA), we remain on track to announce results from the OPUS-2 and OPUS-3 Phase 3 trials in the first half of next year and, together with a manufacturing consistency study, we expect to submit a BLA in the first half of 2028.

For the VAX-31 infant indication, we expect to announce topline data from the primary immunization series and booster dose of the ongoing Phase 2 study, either sequentially or together, by the end of the first half of 2027.”
